description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have Sakashima the Impostor enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Sakashima the Impostor trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
